<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY ext "External Entity Text">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<!-- Root level comment combining namespaces and entities -->
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2" ns2:attr="value">
  <child>&ext;</child>
  <ns2:sub>
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block inside namespaced element with <tags> & entities ]]>
  </ns2:sub>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book+)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, desc)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT desc (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY pub "O'Reilly Media">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY internal 'Param Entity Expanded'>">
  %param;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY cover SYSTEM "cover.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?pi-target processing instruction data?>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.org/catalog">
  <!-- Comment before book element -->
  <book id="1">
    <title>XML Parsing & Security</title>
    <desc>
      <![CDATA[
        Detailed description containing markup-like strings: <book> &pub;
      ]]>
    </desc>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

  </arc:record>
</archive>

  <!ELEMENT note (to, from, heading, body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT heading (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY company "ACME Corp">

  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY legal SYSTEM "legal.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<!-- Notice: Confidential Information -->
<note xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
  <to>Tove</to>
  <from>Jani</from>
  <heading>Reminder</heading>
  <body>
    <![CDATA[
      Don't forget me this weekend! ©
    ]]>
  </body>
</note>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE svg [
  <!ELEMENT svg ANY>
  <!ENTITY base "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!ENTITY % dtd_frag "<!ATTLIST svg version CDATA #REQUIRED>">
  %dtd_frag;
  <?xml-stylesheet href="svg.css" type="text/css"?>
]>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" version="1.1">
  <!-- Scalable Vector Graphics wrapper comment -->
  <defs>
    <script type="text/javascript">
      <![CDATA[
        function init(evt) {
          if (window.console) console.log("Loaded &base;");
        }
      ]]>
    </script>
  </defs>
</svg>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY rdb "Relational DB">
  <!ENTITY system-info "OS: Linux">
  <!ENTITY % expansion "<!ENTITY nested '&system-info;'>">
  %expansion;
  <?db-control type="refresh" interval="30"?>
]>
<database xmlns="http://example.com/db" xmlns:db="http://example.com/db/ns">
  <!-- Database entry point comment -->
  <db:record id="rec1">
    <![CDATA[
      System status: &nested; &rdb;
    ]]>
  </db:record>
</database>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE testsuite [
  <!ELEMENT testsuite (testcase+)>
  <!ELEMENT testcase (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY pass "PASSED">
  <!ENTITY fail "FAILED">
  <!ENTITY result "&pass;/&fail;">
  <!NOTATION log SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY logfile "test.log" NDATA log>
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="report.xsl"?>
]>
<!-- Automated Test Suite Wrapper -->
<testsuite xmlns="http://qa.example.org/schema" xmlns:ts="http://qa.example.org/schema/ts">

    <![CDATA[
      Test execution result code: &result;
    ]]>
  </ts:testcase>
</testsuite>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE message [
  <!ELEMENT message (header, body)>
  <!ELEMENT header (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY msg-id "MSG-9999">
  <!ENTITY % extra-elements "<!ELEMENT meta (#PCDATA)>">
  %extra-elements;
  <?msg-routing via="gateway-01"?>
]>
<!-- Message Envelope Structure -->
<message xmlns="http://msg.example.org" xmlns:envelope="http://msg.example.org/env">
  <envelope:header>&msg-id;</envelope:header>
  <body id="b1">
    <![CDATA[
      Payload contains arbitrary markup: <envelope:header> &msg-id; </envelope:header>
    ]]>
  </body>
  <meta>Metadata Section</meta>
</message>
